Meanwhile, legendary musician Elvis Costello is opening up about his early days, including how he got his iconic stage name and the story behind one of his most beloved songs, 'Alison'. In other news, country music is getting a boost from Texas-native Wade Bowen, who's being hailed as a true representative of the state's music scene. items.title: AP Entertainment SummaryBrief at 4:10 a.m. EDT | Features | rutlandherald.com
items.excerpt: Singer Chris Brown to be sentenced over bottle attack at a London nightclub LONDON (AP) — Grammy-winning singer Chris Brown is to be sentenced Monday over brawling at a London nightclub in 2003. Brown pleaded guilty to a count of affray at London’s Southwark Crown Court in July for attacking a music producer with a bottle on the head. Brown had denied attacking Abraham Diaw with a bottle at the Tape nightclub in the swanky Mayfair neighborhood. But prosecutors said the fight was caught on surveillance camera in front of a club full of people. Brown’s friend and vocal coach Omololu Akinlolu also pleaded guilty to affray. He will be sentenced too. 'You Can See Everything' surges with $19.5M at box office; 'Clayface' takes No. 1 NEW YORK (AP) — DC Studios scored a modest, R-rated win with “Clayface,” landing a $24 million opening weekend, according to studio estimates Sunday. But the biggest success story in theaters remained A24’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary “You Can See Everything,” which pulled in $19.5 million in its first weekend of wide release. The Nathan Fielder, Lance Oppenheim-directed “You Can See Everything” increased from 855 locations to 2,655. In expansion, it continued to blow away expectations. With $45.1 million in two weeks, it already ranks among the highest grossing documentaries ever. items.title: Tokyo Film Festival to Open With Zeze Takahisa's Sukiyaki
items.excerpt: The 39th edition Tokyo International Film Festival (TIFF) will open on Oct. 26 with a gala screening of Zeze Takahisa’s music drama Sukiyaki. Festival organizers also revealed that Yeon Sang-ho‘s zombie action horror film Colony will close this year’s event on Nov. 4. ... Based on true events, Sukiyaki tells the story behind the famed Japanese pop song “Sukiyaki,” sung by crooner Kyu Sakamoto. The song topped the charts in a forward-looking post-war Japan but remarkably became a global phenomenon, holding the No.1 spot on U.S. Billboard charts for three consecutive weeks in 1963. The film, which is a sure-fire bet to be a hit when it opens in Japanese theaters on Dec. 25, depicts the history-making collaboration between the song’s composer Nakamura Hachidai (Okada Junichi), lyricist Ei Rokusuke (Matsuzaka Tori), and Sakamoto (Nakano Taiga). ... “ Sukiyaki tells the dramatic stories of three artists who inspired people in postwar Japan, interwoven with a collection of musical masterpieces. We are delighted to open ... TIFF 2026 runs from Oct. 26 through to Nov. 4.
